title: ToolCall
description: A single tool invocation, assembled by TurnExecutor from streamed ToolCallDeltas and handed to ToolRouter. Carries the trust context, because the Policy Engine cannot decide anything without it (ADR-0012).

compatibility.notes: `trust` is REQUIRED and must never become optional. A ToolCall that reaches the Policy Engine without a trust context cannot be authorized, and the only safe default would be to deny everything — so an optional field here would either break the system or, worse, tempt someone to default it to user_originated. `call_id` must be stable from the first ToolCallDelta through the AuditRecord and the ToolResult; it is the only thing correlating the three.

call_id.description: Stable across ToolCallDelta -> ToolCall -> AuditRecord -> ToolResult.

arguments.description: Validated against the tool's input_schema BEFORE dispatch. ToolRouter rejects a call whose arguments do not validate rather than passing them through and letting the capability fail — the capability may have already done something by then.

trust.description: The FULL context, not just the level, so an audit entry can name which source degraded it.

index.description: Position within a parallel tool-call batch.

idempotency_key.description: Required before any `write` tool may be retried (ADR-0026).

cancellation_token_id.description: ADR-0025. Present so a cancelled turn can abort this call across a process or network boundary.

attempt.description: Retry counter. Greater than 1 is legal ONLY for idempotent calls or calls carrying an idempotency_key.
